col_4: Each GPIO port A pin (GPIO0-GPIO31) corresponds to one bit in this register as shown in Figure 1- 68. Writes of 0 are ignored. This register always reads back a 0. Writing a 1 forces the respective output data latch to toggle from its current state. If the pin is configured as a GPIO output then it will be driven in the opposite direction of its current state. If the pin is not configured as a GPIO output then the latch is toggled but the pin is not driven.
